mapper.sql: N.NOTICE_ID AS ID, N.CATEGORY, N.TITLE, N.SUMMARY, N.CONTENT, N.IS_IMPORTANT = 'Y' AS IMPORTANT, DATE_FORMAT(N.PUBLISHED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `DATE`, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(N.CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(N.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 AS UPDATED_AT
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY N.PUBLISHED_AT DESC, N.NOTICE_ID DESC
